features: [Dual Android OS] A smart projector truly designed for streaming is HERE! India’s 1st projector with dual Android System one open source and other Certified 4K GTV with one-click access to popular streaming apps like Netflix, Disney+, YouTube, Prime Video, and many more all support 4K. Unlike other unauthorized Android TV projectors, Its 1st Indian projector support inbuilt apps in 4K HDR, BS50 MAX (GTV) is a truly smart projector you won't need to buy a separate TV stick anymore the built-in 4K GTV System will support 4K HRD10, will get OTA updates regularly to ensure you have the latest features, enhancing security and stability.

[BS50 MAX GTV] Native 1080p and 4K HDR Support with Upgraded 3000 ANSI Peak Lamp Brightness with 50000:1 High Dynamic Contrast Ratio, Short Throw ratio 1:10 which allow you to build more than 100 inch screen just from 9 feet distance, 250 inch Max home cinema Screen size – LTPO New Generation Highly Transparent FHD Cinema-scopic Wide Screen LCD (16:9 110% NTSC Wide Color Gamut - 762 cm) Razor-sharp clarity and ultra-detailed visuals, making every frame come alive. Long Lamp Life - 50000 Hours | HDMI ARC, Dolby Audio for Internal GTV Source. Next Gen Wi-Fi 6 + Dual Band Wi Fi (2.4 Ghz + 5 Ghz)

[Cross Matrix LED] Powered by Cross Matrix LED technology, delivering bright, vivid, and detailed visuals with 3000 ANSI Lumens (With inbuilt Lamp Brightness Control System) – Built to thrive in both dim and well-lit rooms, ensuring crystal-clear visuals even in daylight. Experience true-to-life brightness that enhances every viewing environment. Dynamic Contrast Ratio: 50000:1 – Deep, inky blacks and brilliant whites for outstanding shadow details and enhanced depth perception. Be ready to immerse in every detail, even in the darkest scenes.

[24W Stereo Speaker] Built-in 24W powerful Hi-Fi enclosed cavity speaker with V Dimension Stereo throw which creates virtual surround sound, Powered by 12x2 Watt Independent DSP amplifier delivering immersive sound. With double clear sound quality, the powerful speakers give you an immersive experience. HDMI setup allows HDMI ARC, Dolby Audio for internal GTV only, connect high quality sound System to build your dream home theater.

[Closed Engine] Comes with a Closed Optomechanics Electro thermal Cooling technology Engine gives high end cooling and reduced dust issue by 99% compare to regular engine. Closed Engine technology gives high end cooling and reduced dust issue compare to regular engine. 1st Projector with option to control Fan speed.
[Fully Automatic] is equipped with an AI based Smart Algorithm 3.0 Full auto Projection camera that effectively improves focusing, Auto (Focus+Keystone+Obstacle Avoidance+Tilt)

Warranty Information - BORSSO Indian Brand with 1 year (12 months) Comprehensive off site warranty on Projector and 2 Years on Lamp provided by BORSSO from date of purchase | It is mandatory to register warranty of your product to avail warranty benefits within 10 days from the date of delivery. For more details please brand website.
